role: Structure start probe: offers every chunk of a region to fresh mineshaft, stronghold, temple and village generators (dim 0) or MapGenNetherBridge (dim -1) with private empty structure data and writes every start (type, chunk, piece tree with bounding boxes) to starts.jsonl; also hosts the shared canonical NBT-to-JSON canon() many probes use.
used_by: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Snapshot.java, Rows.java, AnimalProbe.java, SlimeProbe.java and about 20 other probes (StructuresProbe.canon)
notes: Block placement is not part of this probe (StructureBlocksProbe covers mineshaft blocks). No oracle/src hook.
